text:
Alyssa: HaloEdge EAP — partner asked us to run power-envelope + perf runs under NDA. They sent HW matrix and a vendor telemetry agent. Who owns the benchmark work?
James: I can own partner comms. NDA signed last week. Need bench spec + target metrics. Do we have a power/thermal runbook?
Mike P: Eng-runtime can run perf jobs. Need AMI/drivers and a validated quantized model. Is target model Llama-2-13B-ptq? Also need access to their telemetry agent or IPMI logs.
Sophia: We should use perf-harness v2 (https://internal.redwood/perf-harness-v2). It supports watt sampling and KV cache pins. I can create run configs and a minimal prompt set.
Alyssa: Partner only allows remote telemetry via their agent (no direct IPMI). It's permitted in the NDA. James — can you get the agent binary + schema?
James: They sent a signed bundle earlier: halo-agent v0.9 + telemetry schema (JSON). Uploaded to: https://dropbox.redwood/haloedge/halo-agent-v0.9.zip 
James: Partner also exposes a `power-mode` flag that caps TDP on the device (modes: performance|balanced|conserve).
Mike P: Quick bench command I’ll run once we have image and agent:
```
./perf_harness.py --model llama-2-13b-ptq --dataset perf_v0.json \
  --telemetry-agent ./halo-agent --tuning power_mode=balanced \
  --batches 1,4,8 --seq-len 512
```
CI-bot: deploy job queued: perf-run-1738459012-01 -> worker-pool-dedicated, ETA ~18m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sophia: I’ll curate the prompt set focusing on latency p99 and energy-per-token. Suggest baseline metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, joules/token. Start with 20 tokens/request.
Alyssa: Plan: initial sanbox runs by Fri. Owners: Mike (bench ops), Sophia (evals/metrics), James (partner comms). I’ll coordinate marketing/legal asks for embargoed announcement.
James: Partner asked for a potential embargoed joint blog if results look good. They want a short co-authorable draft.
Elaine (Legal): Noted — NDA allows embargoed co-announcements. I’ll need the list of data fields we plan to publish and the draft before any public mention. Send me the telemetry schema and sample outputs.
Alyssa: Thanks Elaine. James — please drop sample outputs from the first run into the shared folder and tag Elaine.
Mike P: One potential blocker: halo-agent requires kernel module halo-kmod v1.2 which needs sysadmin approval on dedicated boxes. Filing infra ticket now.
James: I’ll ask partner for a fallback: agent-less csv export if sysadmin denies kmod.
Sophia: If we get only CSV telemetry, we can still compute joules/token but we’ll lose high-res power sampling. Documenting degradation modes in the runbook.
Alyssa: Great. Everyone, please update the run checklist in the shared doc: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/haloedge-eap. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
